_comment: Engine releases Agente is tested against. A development build bundles only audio.cpp (Vulkan); the release workflow sets NATIVE_RUNTIME_ENGINES=audio,llama,whisper so the installers carry llama.cpp (cpu, vulkan, cuda, sycl) and whisper.cpp too — packaging refuses a release without them. Settings recommends these same versions for the runtimes the user downloads instead. scripts/fetch-native-runtimes.mjs reads the same file.
